statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer m >= 1 and a collection of m pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets S_1, ..., S_m of the index set {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1} whose union is exactly {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1}, such that for every j with 1 <= j <= m: (a) for any two indices i, i' in S_j with i < i', we have nums[i] < nums[i']; and (b) the cardinality of S_j is at least k.
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order (i.e., for all i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[j]); and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v, multiplied by k, is at most len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail).
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = true, for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v is at most floor(len(nums) / k).
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = true, there exists a valid partition of the index set {0, ..., len(nums)-1} into exactly maxfreq pairwise disjoint strictly increasing subsequences, each of length at least k, where maxfreq is the maximum, over all integers v, of the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = false, for every collection of pairwise disjoint strictly increasing subsequences whose union is the index set {0, ..., len(nums)-1}, at least one subsequence has length less than k.
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = true, for every valid partition of the index set {0, ..., len(nums)-1} into pairwise disjoint strictly increasing subsequences each of length at least k, the number of subsequences in the partition is at least maxfreq, where maxfreq is the maximum frequency of any value in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = true, for every valid partition of the index set {0, ..., len(nums)-1} into pairwise disjoint strictly increasing subsequences each of length at least k, the number of subsequences in the partition is at most floor(len(nums) / k).
preconditions: 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10^5; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r2 on input (nums, k2) and a result r1 on input (nums, k1), if r2 = true then r1 = true.
preconditions: Let k1 and k2 be integers with 1 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(nums) <= 10^5. Assume nums is sorted in non-decreasing order and 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
